name: Carbacid Investments plc
source: Carbacid Investments plc audited consolidated statement of cash flows, annual report for the year ended 31 July 2026, printed page 27 (KSh'000). Figures stored in absolute KES. Capital Expenditure is the sum of purchases of property plant and equipment, intangible assets and investment property, each as printed. FY2026 and FY2025 only: the prior feed's FY2024 to FY2022 columns did not sum to their own net change and could not be reconciled to an audited statement, so they are dropped rather than carried.
